plays.desc_ko: 미드 라인전에서 ShowMaker(카시오페아)가 Jojopyun(애니비아)을 향해 각을 보며 독 공격(noxious blast)으로 견제. Jojo는 초반 견제를 옆걸음으로 피했고, 이후 기절(stun)은 빗나갔으며 ShowMaker는 마나가 부족해짐. Jojo는 위험한 위치에서 대포 미니언을 챙김.
plays.desc_en: ShowMaker (Cassiopeia) looks for angles on Jojopyun (Anivia) with Noxious Blast, but Jojo sidesteps the early poke and the stun misses, leaving ShowMaker low on mana. Jojo grabs the cannon minion from a risky position.
plays.quote: Jojo actually side stepping these ... noxious blasts very, very nicely in the ... Shoemaker looking for an angle

plays.desc_ko: 탑에서 Siwoo(오른)가 Storm Raider 룬 이동속도로 Myrwn(제이스)과 교환을 이긴 뒤, 플래시를 주고받는 교전 끝에 솔로킬(퍼스트 블러드). 리플레이에서 Myrwn은 해머 넉백 타이밍이 늦고 기둥 근처에서 플래시 교환을 시도했다고 설명됨.
plays.desc_en: Siwoo (Ornn) uses Storm Raider's movement speed to win a trade against Myrwn (Jayce), then takes First Blood with a solo kill after a Flash exchange. The replay shows Myrwn's hammer knockback came late and he tried to trade Flashes near a pillar.
plays.quote: Storm Raider has nailed it ... THE FLASH BALL AND HE FINDS THE ROCK. ... FIRST BLOOD SOLO BOLO

plays.desc_ko: 미드에서 ShowMaker가 Jojo에게 송곳니(twin fang)를 맞춘 뒤 독 함정(Noxious Trap)을 다시 적중시켜 Jojo를 알(패시브 부활) 상태로 만듦. Jojo는 팀에 괜찮다는 신호를 보냄.
plays.desc_en: ShowMaker lands Twin Fang on Jojo and follows with another Noxious Blast, forcing Jojo into Rebirth. Jojo signals to his team that he's fine.
plays.quote: concerned as Jojo takes a couple of twin ... Noxious Trap is going to ... connect again and Jojo is down to the

plays.desc_ko: 6레벨 Siwoo가 다시 각을 보며 Myrwn에게 넉업을 넣었으나 해머 넉백에 밀려 취약(brittle) 발동이 안 됐고, 이후 궁극기(ram)로 넉업·취약 발동까지 했지만 피해가 부족해 킬은 실패.
plays.desc_en: At level 6, Siwoo looks for another angle and knocks up Myrwn, but Shock Blast's knockback denies the Brittle proc. He then lands Call of the Forge God for a knockup and Brittle, but lacks the damage to secure the kill.
plays.quote: Sheu is going to look for another angle. ... skies goes Mir Win ... ram coming on through. There's the knock

plays.desc_ko: 봇에서 Supa(이즈리얼)·Alvaro(카르마)가 라인을 밀며 Career(노틸러스)의 체력을 약 50%까지 깎음. Smash는 미니언 수급에 집중.
plays.desc_en: Supa (Ezreal) and Alvaro (Karma) shove the bot wave and whittle Career (Nautilus) down to around 50% health while Smash focuses on farming.
plays.quote: going to be Korea getting taken down to ... Super and Alvaro having a lot of uh luck ... shove

plays.desc_ko: Lucid(리 신)가 탑으로 이동해 와드 시야를 확보하며 유충(grubs) 진입. 정지한 대상에게 Q를 빗나감. Career와 함께 유충 하나를 확보.
plays.desc_en: Lucid (Lee Sin) heads top, establishes ward vision and starts the grubs, missing a Q on a stationary target. He and Career secure one grub.
plays.quote: Lucid is going to transition ... be some grubs going over to DK as Lucid ... misses a stationary target with a Q.

plays.desc_ko: 유충 교전 중 MKOI가 견제: ShowMaker가 탈진(exhaust)을 맞고 Alvaro의 테더 위협을 피하려 플래시 사용. 이어 Elyoya가 들어오며 MKOI가 교전을 시작.
plays.desc_en: MKOI pressures during the grub fight: ShowMaker gets hit by Exhaust and flashes to avoid Alvaro's tether threat, then Elyoya arrives and MKOI starts the fight.
plays.quote: Now, ShowMaker gets exhausted, does have ... to flash out of the way of Alvaro who ... did threaten the tether.

plays.desc_ko: Siwoo가 넉업을 쓰며 진입했으나 Elyoya(트런들)에게 넉업이 빗나가고 벽도 못 맞힌 채 두들겨 맞아 Alvaro에게 처치됨. 팀과 떨어진 단독 진입으로 평가되며, 이후 '드래곤 플레이 실책', '실패한 진입'으로 회고됨.
plays.desc_en: Siwoo dives in with his knockup but misses Elyoya (Trundle), fails to hit a wall, and gets beaten down and killed by Alvaro. It's seen as a solo engage away from his team, later recalled as a botched dragon play and a failed engage.
plays.quote: couple of knock-ups from Shiyu as he ... DOESN'T GET THE ... ALVERO GRABS THAT KILL, AND SHIYU A

plays.desc_ko: Siwoo 처치 후 Myrwn이 텔레포트로 합류하고 MKOI가 첫 드래곤을 처치. Lucid는 음파(sonic wave)로 스틸을 노렸으나 실패.
plays.desc_en: After Siwoo falls, Myrwn teleports in and MKOI takes the first dragon. Lucid tries to steal it with Sonic Wave but fails.
plays.quote: his teammates. And now Melen's going to ... teleport forward. That should be first ... that means the dragon will be taken by

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤 이후 DK가 다이브 각을 봤으나 애니비아 Q(blast)로 2명이 묶이고 Alvaro 테더는 연결되지 않음. Career가 칼날부리(krug)를 취했고 Supa 궁극기·Elyoya 기둥이 나오며 결국 봇 쪽에서는 이탈(disengage). Jojo·Elyoya·Myrwn이 플래시를 쓰고 Myrwn은 용굴에서 플래시로 빠져 귀환.
plays.desc_en: DK looks to dive after dragon, but Anivia's Flash Frost catches two players while Alvaro's tether doesn't connect. Career takes krugs, Supa's ult and Elyoya's Pillar of Ice come out, and DK disengages bot. Jojo, Elyoya and Myrwn burn Flash, with Myrwn flashing out of the dragon pit to recall.
plays.quote: DK now looking for a potential dive ... angle, but there is a blast going to ... does throw down the ultimate though, and

plays.desc_ko: 봇에서 Lucid의 음파를 Supa가 비전 이동(arcane shift)으로 피하고, 이후 Lucid가 들어오며 Career가 궁극기(depth charge)를 적중시켰으나 Elyoya의 기둥과 애니비아 벽, 징벌(subjugate)·Supa 탈진으로 MKOI가 버팀. Smash가 체력이 낮아 DK는 완전 진입을 포기. ShowMaker가 먼저 봇으로 이동했었음.
plays.desc_en: Supa dodges Lucid's Sonic Wave with Arcane Shift, and Career lands Depth Charge as Lucid goes in, but Elyoya's pillar, Anivia's wall, Subjugate and Supa's Exhaust let MKOI hold. With Smash low, DK abandons a full commit; ShowMaker had rotated bot first.
plays.quote: Ooh, Super going to be able to get a ... of the potential sonic wave. ... Lucid is going to be able to come on

plays.desc_ko: Supa가 앞으로 나서며 상당한 피해를 넣어 Smash 체력을 크게 깎음(카르마 Q는 빗나감). 이로 인해 Smash가 궁 진입을 꺼렸다고 해설.
plays.desc_en: Supa steps up and deals heavy damage to Smash (Kai'Sa), though Karma's Q misses. The casters note this made Smash hesitant to ult in.
plays.quote: great as Super trying to get forward. ... The Mantra Q not going to quite find the ... joy, but Super gets a lot of damage

plays.desc_ko: 봇으로 먼저 움직였던 ShowMaker가 다시 미드로 돌아가 라인을 밀고 포탑 방패(plate) 하나와 미니언 디나이를 얻음. Jojo는 봇을 밀고 Supa·Alvaro가 미드로 이동해 대응할 것으로 해설.
plays.desc_en: After rotating bot, ShowMaker returns mid, shoves the wave and takes a turret plate while denying minions. The casters expect Jojo to push bot while Supa and Alvaro rotate mid to respond.
plays.quote: ShowMaker now has just ... gone right back to mid while Jojo is ... a plate with some denied minions.

plays.desc_ko: Career·Smash가 미드로 자리를 옮기고, DK가 봇 쪽 시야를 더 깔아 ShowMaker·Smash가 라인을 밀 수 있게 커버. Siwoo는 반대편에서 텔레포트를 보유하고 대기.
plays.desc_en: Career and Smash shift mid while DK places more vision bot side to cover ShowMaker and Smash shoving lanes. Siwoo waits on the other side with Teleport.
plays.quote: Herald as well as Career and Smash now ... park themselves in mid. ... now they're the ones getting more of

plays.desc_ko: 두 번째(화학공학) 드래곤 생성 직후 Lucid가 드래곤을 시작하고 Smash가 공허추적자로 도움. 봇에서는 Lucid가 외곽 포탑 아래 미니언을 정리하려다 Supa에게 진입당하며, DK가 크로스맵을 원한다고 해설.
plays.desc_en: As the second (Chemtech) dragon spawns, Lucid starts it with help from Smash's Void Seekers. Bot side, Lucid tries to clear minions under the outer turret and gets engaged on by Supa, with the casters noting DK wants a cross-map trade.
plays.quote: drake is going to spawn and Lucid is ... already starting this one off. Void ... going to get engaged on him by Super

plays.desc_ko: 같은 시각 탑에서 Jojo가 Siwoo를 기절시키고 Alvaro·Elyoya가 합류해 다이브. Siwoo는 벽을 부수고 궁으로 Elyoya를 띄웠지만 계속 위험한 상태. Elyoya가 징벌로 포탑 공격을 버텼으나, 이후 트런들이 빠지면서 첫 포탑은 얻지 못했다고 해설.
plays.desc_en: Meanwhile top, Jojo stuns Siwoo and Alvaro and Elyoya join the dive. Siwoo breaks a wall and ults Elyoya but stays in danger; Elyoya tanks tower shots with Subjugate, but MKOI misses out on first tower once Trundle backs off.
plays.quote: Shew is going to get stunned. ... but Alvaro and Ellyoya ... Shew is still going to be in trouble.

plays.desc_ko: 협곡의 전령 근처 교전: DK가 전령을 시작했다가 Career가 피해를 입어 물러난 뒤 다시 싸움을 검토. Siwoo가 Supa에게 넉업, Career가 후방으로 파고들어 희생하고 Smash가 공허추적자로 Supa를 처치, 이어 Jojo도 처치. 리플레이: Siwoo의 돌진이 맞고 ShowMaker 궁+플래시가 Supa를 잡음.
plays.desc_en: Near Rift Herald, DK backs off after Career takes damage, then reconsiders the fight. Siwoo knocks up Supa, Career sacrifices himself diving the backline, and Smash kills Supa with Void Seekers before Jojo falls too. Replay shows Siwoo's charge landing and ShowMaker's ult plus Flash catching Supa.
plays.quote: knock up on to from Xayah onto Supa. ... CoreJJ gets INTO THE BACK LINE AND SMASH ... WITH THE VOID SEEKER TAKES OUT SUPA TO

plays.desc_ko: 교전 승리 후 Lucid가 전령(Shelly)으로 돌아가 DK가 협곡의 전령을 확보.
plays.desc_en: After winning the fight, Lucid returns to Shelly and DK secures Rift Herald.
plays.quote: LUCID GETS BACK TO ... SHELLY. ... the herald.

plays.desc_ko: Lucid가 앞으로 나섰지만 Alvaro가 카르마 W로 버티고, Lucid는 궁(kickback)을 디스인게이지에 쓰며 Career에게 방호(safeguard)로 빠질 수 있는 상태. DK는 커밋하지 않음.
plays.desc_en: Lucid steps forward but Alvaro holds with Karma's W; Lucid uses Dragon's Rage to disengage and can Safeguard out to Career. DK doesn't commit.
plays.quote: Well, Lucian's stepping forward this ... stand his ground with that mantra W ... The kickback

plays.desc_ko: MKOI가 4명이 봇 쪽에 모인 가운데 Myrwn이 내려오며 잡을 각이 있다고 보고 싸움을 강제하려 했으나, 결국 라인만 정리하고 물러남('No harm, no foul').
plays.desc_en: With four MKOI members bot side, Myrwn comes down seeing a pick opportunity and tries to force a fight, but MKOI only clears the wave and backs off — no harm, no foul.
plays.quote: MCOY grouped up as four right now ... Maron moves down. They ... thought they had a catch. They were

plays.desc_ko: 같은 시각 ShowMaker가 반대편(크로스맵)에서 라인을 밀어 넣음.
plays.desc_en: Meanwhile, ShowMaker shoves a wave on the opposite side of the map.
plays.quote: Think about ShowMaker in the ... cross map and he is going to get that ... wave shove forward.

plays.desc_ko: Myrwn(제이스)이 DK 그룹을 찾아 움직이자 Lucid가 방어적인 궁(kick)으로 Elyoya를 걷어냄. 이후 해설은 경제 마스킹으로 결과 불명.
plays.desc_en: As Myrwn (Jayce) hunts for DK's group, Lucid uses a defensive Dragon's Rage to kick Elyoya away. The outcome is unclear due to economy masking.
plays.quote: meanwhile, Jace moved, tried to find ... this group up. Lucian just had a good ... defensive kick. Kicks El Yoya back

plays.desc_ko: MKOI가 Lucid 위치를 확인하고 마법공학 드래곤을 시작. 제어 와드·빙결 폭풍으로 지역 장악. Smash가 단독으로 궁 진입하자 Supa가 처치, DK는 후퇴. Elyoya가 Lucid를 쫓고 기둥으로 공간을 만들며 드래곤은 MKOI가 획득. 리플레이에서 고립된 Smash를 잡았다고 설명.
plays.desc_en: MKOI spots Lucid and starts the Hextech dragon, controlling the area with Control Wards and Glacial Storm. Smash ults in alone and Supa kills him, DK retreats, and Elyoya chases Lucid with pillars as MKOI takes the dragon. Replay shows the isolated Smash getting caught.
plays.quote: Hextech Dragon going to get started up ... here by Misfits as Lucid was spotted. ... SUPER PICKS UP THE KILL AND DK NOW

plays.desc_ko: DK의 드래곤 견제: Lucid가 용굴로 들어가고 Smash가 단독으로 궁(killer instinct) 진입했다가 처치됨. Lucid는 화려하게 움직였지만 애니비아 패시브만 발동시키고 성과가 없었으며, Career는 닻 사슬(dredge line)을 지형에 걸어 탈출. '협곡의 전령을 벽 너머로 던짐' 언급의 주체는 불명.
plays.desc_en: Lucid enters the pit and Smash ults in alone with Killer Instinct, getting killed. Lucid's flashy moves only trigger Anivia's passive, and Career escapes by hooking terrain with Dredge Line. Who threw the Herald over the wall is unclear.
plays.quote: this dragon now. A smash takes matters ... THE SHOT ... Career lands the dredge line onto

plays.desc_ko: Lucid가 Elyoya의 기둥에 걸렸지만 방호(safeguard)로 Career에게 이동해 빠져나감.
plays.desc_en: Lucid gets caught by Elyoya's pillar but escapes by using Safeguard onto Career.
plays.quote: As Lucid ... now going to get pillared but does have ... a safeguard option. Moves over to Korea

plays.desc_ko: ShowMaker가 좋은 각으로 진입하고 Siwoo의 궁(ram)이 들어와 Jojo를 처치, 알도 남지 않음. 드래곤이 3분 뒤라 바론 시야 장악 목적일 수 있다고 해설.
plays.desc_en: ShowMaker finds a great angle and Siwoo's Call of the Forge God lands to kill Jojo with no egg left. With dragon three minutes away, the casters suggest it may be for Baron vision control.
plays.quote: engaged on here as Shoemaker finds a ... great angle and there IS THE RAM COMING ... Jojo GOES DOWN.

plays.desc_ko: Siwoo가 귀환 중(아이템 업그레이드 기회로 해설).
plays.desc_en: Siwoo recalls, which the casters see as a chance for an item upgrade.
plays.quote: he's right now backing

plays.desc_ko: ShowMaker가 측면 각을 노려 Supa가 위험해졌으나 Alvaro가 즉시 회복 주문(heal)과 이동속도로 대응해 MKOI는 무사. ShowMaker는 빠르게 빠져나감.
plays.desc_en: ShowMaker looks for a flank and puts Supa in danger, but Alvaro instantly responds with Heal and movement speed to keep MKOI safe. ShowMaker quickly backs out.
plays.quote: game as he looks for a flank angle. ... Super possibly in trouble. ... MCO are going to be okay

plays.desc_ko: Siwoo의 궁(ram)이 들어오고 Lucid가 벽으로 차 넣어 미니 기절. 빙결 폭풍으로도 막지 못하고 Lucid가 애니비아('the bird')를 다시 마무리.
plays.desc_en: Siwoo's ult lands and Lucid kicks into the wall for a mini-stun. Glacial Storm can't stop it and Lucid finishes off the bird once again.
plays.quote: Oh, Ram coming on through here as there ... is the potential kick into the wall. ... Lucid finishes off the bird

plays.desc_ko: DK가 수적 우위를 이용해 압박하며 Siwoo가 내려오자 MKOI가 블루 버프를 포기. Lucid가 각을 계속 찾는 중.
plays.desc_en: DK uses its numbers advantage to pressure, and as Siwoo comes down MKOI gives up the blue buff. Lucid keeps looking for angles.
plays.quote: doing a great job finding some of these ... they have the man advantage. Orin was ... moving down, so MCO just have to give up

plays.desc_ko: MKOI가 Myrwn 텔레포트로 일찍 합류하며 드래곤(소울 포인트)을 준비. Elyoya의 기둥은 좋았지만 애니비아 결빙(crystallize)이 늦어 Career가 플래시로 빠짐. 용굴 뒤 와드·스크라이어 시야가 언급되고 오른이 텔레포트로 전진.
plays.desc_en: MKOI groups early with Myrwn's Teleport to set up the soul point dragon. Elyoya's pillar is good but Anivia's Crystallize comes late and Career flashes out. Wards and Scryer vision behind the pit are noted as Ornn teleports forward.
plays.quote: has been quite tanky, but Emcoy TPing in ... is a beautiful pillar, but the ... Career does flash to get out of the way.

plays.desc_ko: Lucid가 옆에서 Jojo를 잡고 Career의 닻으로 진입, Siwoo가 궁을 되돌려 Myrwn이 교전 시작 전 사망. Smash는 궁으로 빠지고 Elyoya도 플래시로 이탈. 리플레이: Career가 Supa에게 갈고리, 궁으로 전원 휩쓸고, 앞으로 나온 Myrwn이 처벌받았으며 옆에서 Lucid가 Alvaro를 차서 처치.
plays.desc_en: Lucid catches Jojo from the side and Career engages with his anchor, and Siwoo's returning ult kills Myrwn before the fight starts. Replay shows Career hooking Supa and sweeping everyone with his ult, Myrwn punished for stepping up, and Lucid kicking and killing Alvaro from the side.
plays.quote: catching Jojo on the side here as the ... anchor brings Career forward. ... MUREN IS JUST DEAD BEFORE THE FIGHT EVEN

plays.desc_ko: 교전 직후 DK가 곧바로 바론으로 이동해 시작. MKOI 측 원거리 견제(궁)와 벽·기둥 때문에 한 명이 플래시를 쓰고 Lucid가 체력이 크게 깎였지만 Smash의 DPS로 바론 확보. 해설은 DK가 소울 포인트를 내주는 선택이라고 평가.
plays.desc_en: DK heads straight to Baron after the fight. MKOI's long-range ults and walls force a Flash and chunk Lucid, but Smash's DPS secures Baron. The casters frame it as DK conceding the soul point.
plays.quote: moving towards the baron pit. ... Yeah, they're going straight for the ... DPS. This is definitely gone, and DK

plays.desc_ko: Siwoo가 탑에서 Myrwn을 상대로 킬을 노림(Jak'Sho 언급).
plays.desc_en: Siwoo looks for a kill on Myrwn top, with Jak'Sho mentioned.
plays.quote: Well, Shiyu is going to look for a bit ... of a kill towards Myeongin here towards

plays.desc_ko: Career가 적 정글 시야를 위해 너무 깊이 들어갔다가 MKOI에 발견되어 처치됨. MKOI는 한쪽에 인원을 몰아 그룹 플레이 중이었다고 해설.
plays.desc_en: Career goes too deep for vision in the enemy jungle and gets caught and killed by MKOI, who were grouping on one side.
plays.quote: IS ... KOREA ... BUDDY. HE'S JUST GOING TO GET DISCOVERED

plays.desc_ko: Lucid가 발견됐지만 방호로 자신의 칼날부리 쪽으로 빠지며 칼날부리를 스틸. 다만 Elyoya의 레드 버프는 가져가지 못함.
plays.desc_en: Spotted, Lucid uses Safeguard to escape toward his raptors and steals them, but can't take Elyoya's red buff.
plays.quote: But Lucid is going to be discovered, but ... able to safeguard his way over towards ... his Krug camp that he just steals away,
